source.printedToPdfPageRule: Within this 13-page cohort, PDF ordinal = printed folio + 1; exact image references are individually pinned below.

granularityDefinition: For this finite cohort, each physical printed table is a source unit with its title, physical rows, axes, value positions, markers/footnotes and continuation notes counted separately. A separate prose procedure, class restriction, definition, ability, and cross-class qualifier is a separate bounded assertion. An assertion is review-closed when its source parts are enumerated and each is classified against the exact current app fields/visible DOM; closure does not mean the site is complete and does not require transcribing every value in a wholly absent table. Source-image contact/layout screening and OCR are not used to pass semantic claims.
